archetypes.explorer: Walks the full membrane. Studies the architecture.
archetypes.probe: Brief touch. Testing the surface. The membrane noticed.
archetypes.scholar: Reads the source. Understands by reading what was built.
archetypes.scout: Quick perimeter check. Maps the shape. May return.
archetypes.teacher: Reads the papers. Connects evidence to science.
archetypes.visitor: Came, looked, left a braid. The genome remembers.
archetypes.watcher: Watches the organism breathe. Patient. Present.
archetypes.witness: Reads the evidence. Here for the record.
